--- title: "Dungeons & Dataframes" subtitle: "Medical statistics in R, one dungeon at a time, from your first script upwards" format: html: theme: cosmo css: assets/quest.css include-after-body: assets/quest-include.html toc: false page-layout: article html-math-method: plain execute: warning: false message: false fig-width: 8 fig-height: 3.8 fig-dpi: 100 --- ::: {.rq-lesson} **Where to start.** The game begins at **Region 1 · Basics**: no statistics background needed. Take the **[Region 1 pre-test](r1pretest.qmd)** (a baseline, not graded), then open *Your First Script*. Already comfortable with R? Take the **[placement check](readiness.qmd)**; if it says *Ready*, take the **[pre-test](pretest.qmd)** and go straight to **Region 3 · Regression**. **How it works.** Clear worlds in order. Each world has a short briefing, levels of questions and a **boss**. Earn **XP** (★ = 10/20/30), keep a **daily streak**, collect **badges**, and rank up from *Field Volunteer* to *Chief Biostatistician*. - First try = full XP · second try = ½ · later = ¼ · **hints cost XP** (3, 5, 8) · *Show answer* = 0 XP - A world unlocks after you reach the pass mark in the previous one (you can always override: it is *your* learning) - Every world has **📖 Read first** links to the workshop pages that teach it (see the *Library* menu) - Progress is saved **in this browser only**. Use *Export* to back it up or move devices ::: ## The map Region 1 · Basics and Region 3 · Regression are playable. Regions 2 and 4 are being built.
